context: Define path ownership and metadata promotion for draft-to-published posts. Rewrite draft-relative image and companion links at promotion. Build API docs once per release with release commit and artifact digest. Prose builds link or mount those versioned artifacts without importing the package under development.
description: Create an independently promotable prose/site lane for docs, blog posts, images, and redirects, while consuming immutable versioned API docs built from validated package releases. Remove release-date coupling only after the lane passes shadow, production, rollback, link, route, and visual checks.

anti_patterns.dont: Build prose docs by importing arbitrary develop package code
anti_patterns.instead: mount immutable API docs from a validated release
anti_patterns.why: that re-couples site publication to an unvalidated tool state

anti_patterns.dont: Copy drafts to docs without path transformation
anti_patterns.instead: apply and test an explicit publication transform
anti_patterns.why: relative images and companion links change shape

preserves.behavior: Existing blog and docs URLs, images, RSS metadata, and cross-links remain valid.
Versioned API docs remain tied to the exact validated package release that produced them.

prior_art.concept: Preserve the atomic Pages deploy while decoupling content build cadence

verifications.command: uv run sphinx-build -W -b html docs docs/_build/html && uv run sphinx-build -W -b linkcheck docs docs/_build/linkcheck
verifications.description: Sphinx HTML and linkcheck pass against mounted release API docs
Blog publication transform resolves images, companion links, dates, status, and feeds
A prose-only production canary changes site content without changing package, Explorer, or corpus receipts
